fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
There is an option for a MS VS Just-In-Time Debugger "vsjitdebugger.exe" to launch specified executable and attach a debugger.
This option may be used adversaries to execute malicious code by signed verified binary.
The debugger is installed alongside with Microsoft Visual Studio package.
fields.name: Malicious PE Execution by Microsoft Visual Studio Debugger
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\vsjitdebugger.exe" and (not (tgt.process.image.path="*\\vsimmersiveactivatehelper*.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\devenv.exe"))))
